slackGuide.title: Slack Webhook Integration Guide
slackGuide.description: Create a Slack Incoming Webhook to receive BRIDGE notifications in Slack.
slackGuide.step1Desc: Click the link below to go to the Slack API site.
slackGuide.step2Desc: Click "Create New App" button, then select "From scratch".
slackGuide.stepAppNameDesc: Enter an app name and select the Slack workspace to receive notifications.
slackGuide.stepAppNameDetail: Enter your desired app name (e.g. "BRIDGE") and click the "Create App" button.
slackGuide.step3Desc: Click "Incoming Webhooks" from the left menu on the app settings page.
slackGuide.step3Detail: Turn on the "Activate Incoming Webhooks" toggle to enable it.
slackGuide.step4Desc: Click "Add New Webhook to Workspace" button at the bottom of the page.
slackGuide.step4Detail: Select the channel for notifications (e.g. #bridge-alerts) and click "Allow".
slackGuide.step6Desc: Paste the Webhook URL into BRIDGE's Slack integration settings and save.
slackGuide.step6Detail: You can verify the connection is working with the "Test" button.
slackGuide.tipContent: You can add webhooks to multiple channels with a single Slack app. If you want to send notifications to different channels per board, create additional webhooks from the same app.
